pages.text: Radiant Dust is a crafting component made from ground up $(l:arcanearchives:items/rawquartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$(/l). Radiant Dust is generally used in devices where full sized pieces of Radiant Quartz would be too large.$(br2)Radiant Dust can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
